definitions.short: Azrikam , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H5840. Azriqam עַזְרִיקָם proper name, masculine Εζρεικαν , Εζρικαμ etc., 1 descendant of David 1Chr 3:23 . 2 prince in Judah 2Chr 28:7 . 3 Benjamite 1Chr 8:38 ; 9:44 . 4 Levite 1Chr 9:14 ; Neh 11:15 .
definitions.rootNote: from 5828 and active participle of 6965 ; help of an enemy ;

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
